design: First pass replaces donor attention/MLP output at both copied-value positions at one layer0–4site; all other upstream computation native. Capture resulting L5H5 local values. Second fresh receiver pass injects only native-receiver-routing times the weighted local-value change at those two sources into final L5H5 output. Compare to full donor local-value-word target and zero. Task reciprocal,nuisance,identity across lexical cohorts; same alignment exclusions.
limitations: Sufficiency-style site substitution along isolated value readout, not necessity or unique mediation fraction. First-pass upstream changes can propagate through many paths before L5. Does not preserve upstream bypass effects in second pass. Individual sites can substitute/cancel; do not sum causal fractions.
